The [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] known as [[Unreal City/Legends|Unreal City]] employed a number of '''guards'''.

==Overview==
The guards were generally all tall, gaunt figures who towered over [[Metalorn/Legends|Metalorn's]] [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] rulers from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]]. The guards wore metal [[Armor/Legends|armor]] with a [[Color/Legends|blue]] hue and wore helmets with built in respirators. They carried [[Electrostaff/Legends|electrostaffs]].

==History==
When [[Mission to Metalorn (Bail Organa)|attempting]] to escape Metalorn during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] [[Death/Legends|killed]] several of the guards while running out of [[Unreal City/Legends|Unreal City]]. Organa's [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Raymus Antilles/Legends|Raymus Antilles]], also dispatched several guards and numerous [[Droid/Legends|droids]] with the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']], while aiding the Senator and Jedi.
